drhp.business: The Company is a listed real estate developer based in Pune that underwent Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process and was acquired by a Successful Resolution Applicant. During the year under review the Company did not carry out any business operations, so no segment-wise or product-wise performance is applicable.

litigation.note: Investigations are ongoing against the Company under the Maharashtra Protection of Interest of Depositors Act (MPID), the Economic Offences Wing (EOW) - Pune, the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code 2016, and the Prevention of Money Laundering Act 2002; no closure report has been received from the respective departments. Prior to CIRP, the Enforcement Directorate (ED) and Economic Offences Wing conducted search and seizure operations and took custody of the Company's physical and electronic records, which Management has been unable to recover. Read in the Board's Report.

demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Long-term outlook for the Indian real estate sector is expected to remain positive, supported by sustained urbanisation, favourable demographics, and continued economic growth.
- Government initiatives focused on infrastructure development, housing, and urban renewal are expected to strengthen demand across residential and commercial real estate.
- Increasing preference for organised and financially sound developers is likely to continue, creating opportunities for companies with strong execution capabilities and quality project delivery.
- Demand for premium housing, integrated townships, commercial spaces, and mixed-use developments is expected to remain steady, driven by evolving customer preferences and improving lifestyle aspirations.

- The Company will continue to focus on timely execution of projects, prudent capital allocation, effective cost management, and maintaining high standards of quality and customer satisfaction.
- The Company remains committed to exploring growth opportunities while maintaining financial discipline and strengthening its operational capabilities.
